'''Tamanaku''' ({{langx|tmz|Tamañkú}}) is an extinct [[Cariban language]] of [[Venezuela]].

The earliest word list of Tamanaku was published by [[Filippo Salvatore Gilii|Gilij]] in 1780, from his 20-year stay among the Tamanku beginning around 1750.<ref name="Meira-2015">Meira S, Birchall J, Chousou-Polydouri S. 2015. ''[https://www.academia.edu/15980095/A_character-based_internal_classification_of_the_Cariban_language_family A character-based internal classification of the Cariban family]''. Talk presented at the 48th Annual Meeting of the Societas Linguisticae Europaea, Leiden, Netherlands, Sept. 4.</ref>
